svg.title: Ila signs a strictly limited public trial beside her red ledger.
svg.desc: Ila pins open the worn red ledger and signs a trial sheet with separate blank fields for duration and public review. She limits the deployment to seventy-two hours and forbids a quiet extension.
svg.text: Page 25, panel 1 · Close medium shot on Ila signing beside the open red ledger

text.tspan: Ila authorises a seventy-two-hour public trial

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
